# Your Say - PLOS

> A platform for researchers, clinicians, and public health experts to share diverse perspectives on critical global health challenges, from AI in healthcare to gender-based violence and health equity.

Your Say is PLOS's community blog featuring guest contributions on contemporary issues in science, medicine, and public health. The platform emphasizes open access, research ethics, and diverse voices from institutions like Johns Hopkins School of Public Health, Aga Khan University Hospital, and international organizations including WHO, UNICEF, and the World Bank.

## Health Equity and Women's Health

- [The Future of Women's Health: How AI and Smart Financing are Closing the Gaps](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/the-future-of-womens-health-how-ai-and-smart-financing-are-closing-the-gaps): AI and smart financing approaches to improve women's healthcare equity and access
- [No Woman Left Behind: Ending Digital Violence Against Women and Girls with Disabilities](https://yoursay.plos.org/2025/12/no-woman-left-behind-ending-digital-violence-against-women-and-girls-with-disabilities): Researchers discuss technology-facilitated gender-based violence and strategies to end it
- [Gender Bias, Workplace Harassment and Violence Against Women in Healthcare Organizations: A wake up call](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/09/gender-bias-workplace-harassment-and-violence-against-women-in-healthcare-organizations-a-wake-up-call): Gender bias and harassment in healthcare organizations with proposed solutions

## Global Health Challenges and Infectious Diseases

- [World Pneumonia Day: Climate change, migration, and misinformation are combining to hinder global access to a life-saving vaccine against child pneumonia](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/11/world-pneumonia-day-climate-change-migration-and-misinformation-are-combining-to-hinder-global-access-to-a-life-saving-vaccine-against-child-pneumonia): Climate change and misinformation barriers to global pneumonia vaccine access for children
- [Mitigating 'Double Trauma': Enforcing Trauma-Informed Care for Young People Living with HIV](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/mitigating-double-trauma-enforcing-trauma-informed-care-for-young-people-living-with-hiv): Trauma-informed care approaches for young people living with HIV in Pakistan

## Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare Innovation

- [The Potential of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare: Transforming Patient Care and Administrative Efficiency](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/the-potential-of-artificial-intelligence-in-healthcare-transforming-patient-care-and-administrative-efficiency): Healthcare AI applications for improving patient care and administrative efficiency

## Pediatric and Maternal Health

- [It's Time to Improve Care for Children with Advanced Developmental Needs](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/12/its-time-to-improve-care-for-children-with-advanced-developmental-needs): Recommendations for early interventions improving outcomes for children with disabilities
- [Beginning New Lives: Preterm Infant and Mothers Coping](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/beginning-new-lives-preterm-infant-and-mothers-coping): Coping strategies for mothers experiencing depression and anxiety from preterm birth

## Healthcare Systems and Clinical Practice

- [Supporting Older Persons: Strengthening Care Systems is a Key to Dignified Ageing](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/supporting-older-persons-strengthening-care-systems-is-a-key-to-dignified-ageing): Strengthening care systems to support elderly care and dignified aging
- [Alarming Signs: A Hazard Approaching to Crash Cart](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/11/alarming-signs-a-hazard-approaching-to-crash-cart): Nursing knowledge and patient safety in critical care settings and crash cart protocols
- [Objectively Measurable Biomarkers for Positive Health](https://yoursay.plos.org/2024/10/objectively-measurable-biomarkers-for-positive-health): Key biomarkers for determining longer, healthier lives with fewer ailments
